title: Database (Prisma)
summary: Postgres through Prisma 7: the `db` workspace (multi-file schema, migrations, seed, generated client), one pool per process behind the `PRISMA` token, the single import seam, an optional scope extension (soft delete, tenant), `openPrisma()` for scripts
postScaffold: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d  (Postgres 16 on 5432 — or point DATABASE_URL in .env at a database you already have)
yarn db:generate  (the generated client is gitignored; typecheck and the server specs read it)
yarn db:migrate --name init  (`prisma migrate dev` — needs a terminal; CI and deploys run `yarn db:migrate:deploy`)
yarn db:seed  (the three example rows; idempotent)
